objective: Measure HMR warm-update latency after content digests were added to watcher file stamps
method: 30 sequential atomic replacements of one self-accepted .mjs entry after initial load; each sample runs from just before writing the replacement through the updated generation's stdout line
entry: temporary self-accepted ESM entry; no project dependency graph
scope: Warm updates for one small self-accepted JavaScript ESM file on this host; not a TypeScript, multi-module, cold-start, cross-host, or production claim.
file_stamp_algorithm: SHA-1 content digest streamed from the same open file handle used for metadata, with an 8192-byte scratch buffer
